idea: Preallocate the KV cache and write in place
strategy: gpu: preallocate the KV cache to max length and write into it in place instead of torch.cat
rationale: torch.cat copies the entire cache every step: O(T^2) memory traffic over a generation.

edits.search:

            if pk is not None:
                k = torch.cat([pk, k], dim=2)   # grows the cache every step: O(T^2) copying
                v = torch.cat([pv, v], dim=2)
            cache[0], cache[1] = k, v
        Tk = k.shape[2]

if cache is not None:

                buf_v = torch.empty_like(buf_k)
                cache[0], cache[1] = buf_k, buf_v
            buf_k[:, :, n:n + T] = k
            buf_v[:, :, n:n + T] = v
            cache[2] = n + T
            k, v = buf_k[:, :, :n + T], buf_v[:, :, :n + T]

reasoning: One allocation per layer per generation; each step writes T new rows in place and attends over a view of the first n+T rows. Attention math is unchanged so tokens and logits match.
